passages.title: Community Centre Information Pack
passages.intro: Notices and service information for local residents
paras: RIVERBANK COMMUNITY CENTRE — AUTUMN PROGRAMME. Registration opens on Monday 7 September at 9:00 a.m. Residents may register online or at reception. Classes are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. A place is confirmed only when the registration form and any required fee have been received. The centre is closed on statutory holidays.

ROOM BOOKINGS. Meeting rooms may be booked by registered community groups up to eight weeks in advance. A refundable key deposit is required for evening bookings. Groups must leave rooms clean and return furniture to its original position. Food may be served only in rooms with a kitchenette; cooking is not permitted anywhere in the building.

JOB SEARCH DROP-IN. A free employment adviser is available on Tuesdays from 1:00 to 4:00 p.m. No appointment is necessary, but visitors should bring a current résumé if they have one. The adviser can help with online applications and interview preparation. The service cannot guarantee employment or complete applications on a visitor’s behalf.

FITNESS CLASSES. Beginners’ yoga meets Monday and Wednesday evenings. Participants should bring a mat or borrow one from reception, subject to availability. Anyone cancelling a paid class at least 24 hours before it begins may request a credit. Missed classes and late cancellations are not refundable.

qs.q: When does registration for the autumn programme open?
qs.why: The first notice gives the registration date and time.
qs.ev: “Registration opens on Monday 7 September at 9:00 a.m.”

qs.q: A class place is confirmed as soon as a person visits the website.
qs.why: The form and any required fee must be received before a place is confirmed.
qs.ev: “A place is confirmed only when the registration form and any required fee have been received.”

qs.q: Which section says a refundable deposit may be needed?
qs.why: The room booking section mentions an evening key deposit.
qs.ev: “A refundable key deposit is required for evening bookings.”

qs.q: Where is cooking not permitted?
qs.why: The notice states cooking is not permitted anywhere in the building.
qs.ev: “cooking is not permitted anywhere in the building.”

qs.q: On which day is the employment adviser available?
qs.why: The drop-in takes place on Tuesdays.
qs.ev: “available on Tuesdays from 1:00 to 4:00 p.m.”

qs.q: Which service can help with interview preparation?
qs.why: The employment adviser helps with interview preparation.
qs.ev: “help with online applications and interview preparation.”

qs.q: The employment adviser will submit job applications for visitors.
qs.why: The service explicitly cannot complete applications on a visitor’s behalf.
qs.ev: “cannot… complete applications on a visitor’s behalf.”

qs.q: Room bookings can be made up to eight weeks ______.
qs.why: The notice gives the booking window.
qs.ev: “up to eight weeks in advance.”

qs.q: What should yoga participants bring if possible?
qs.why: Participants should bring a mat or borrow one if available.
qs.ev: “Participants should bring a mat or borrow one from reception…”

qs.q: All late cancellations receive a refund.
qs.why: Late cancellations are not refundable.
qs.ev: “Missed classes and late cancellations are not refundable.”

qs.q: Visitors should bring a current ______ to the job search drop-in if they have one.
qs.why: The notice recommends bringing a current résumé.
qs.ev: “visitors should bring a current résumé if they have one.”

qs.q: Choose the best heading for Paragraph B.
qs.why: Paragraph B covers room reservations, deposits and use rules.
qs.ev: “ROOM BOOKINGS.”
opts: Rules for reserving and using rooms

qs.q: The centre’s classes are allocated according to registration order.
qs.why: The notice says classes are allocated first-come, first-served.
qs.ev: “on a first-come, first-served basis.”

passages.title: Staff Handbook: Warehouse Induction
passages.intro: Key procedures for new warehouse employees
paras: WELCOME TO NORTHGATE DISTRIBUTION. All new employees must complete an induction before operating equipment or entering marked restricted zones. Staff must sign in at the front desk and wear their identification badge above the waist. Visitors must remain with an authorised employee at all times.

PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT. High-visibility vests and protective footwear are required on the warehouse floor. Gloves are supplied for handling rough packaging, but they must not be worn near rotating machinery because they may become caught. Eye protection is mandatory in the battery-charging area. Report damaged equipment to a supervisor rather than attempting an unauthorised repair.

SHIFT HANDOVER. At the end of a shift, workers should record unfinished tasks, shortages and any equipment faults in the digital logbook. The incoming worker must acknowledge the entry. Urgent hazards should be reported verbally to the supervisor immediately; a written entry alone is not sufficient.

ABSENCE AND TRAINING. Employees who cannot attend a scheduled shift should telephone the duty manager as early as possible, preferably at least two hours before the shift begins. Text messages to colleagues do not count as official notification. Refresher safety training takes place every six months, and employees who miss a session must arrange a make-up session before returning to the relevant task.

qs.q: What must new employees do before operating equipment?
qs.why: The handbook makes induction a requirement before equipment operation.
qs.ev: “must complete an induction before operating equipment…”

qs.q: Visitors may walk around the warehouse alone if they wear a badge.
qs.why: Visitors must remain with an authorised employee at all times.
qs.ev: “Visitors must remain with an authorised employee at all times.”

qs.q: Which paragraph explains what to record at the end of a shift?
qs.why: Paragraph C describes the digital logbook and handover information.
qs.ev: “record unfinished tasks, shortages and any equipment faults…”

qs.q: The handbook recommends reporting urgent hazards only through the digital logbook.
qs.why: Urgent hazards must also be reported verbally immediately.
qs.ev: “a written entry alone is not sufficient.”

qs.q: Identification badges must be worn above the ______.
qs.why: The first paragraph specifies badge placement.
qs.ev: “wear their identification badge above the waist.”

qs.q: When should gloves not be worn?
qs.why: Gloves can become caught in rotating machinery.
qs.ev: “they must not be worn near rotating machinery…”

qs.q: Every employee must complete refresher safety training every six months.
qs.why: The handbook states that refresher training takes place every six months.
qs.ev: “Refresher safety training takes place every six months…”

qs.q: Who should receive a report about damaged equipment?
qs.why: The handbook instructs staff to report damage to a supervisor.
qs.ev: “Report damaged equipment to a supervisor…”

qs.q: Which record must the incoming worker acknowledge?
qs.why: The incoming worker must acknowledge the handover entry.
qs.ev: “The incoming worker must acknowledge the entry.”

qs.q: An absent employee should telephone the duty manager preferably two hours before the ______ begins.
qs.why: The handbook gives this recommended notice period.
qs.ev: “at least two hours before the shift begins.”

qs.q: What should an employee do after missing refresher training?
qs.why: The handbook requires a make-up session before returning to the relevant task.
qs.ev: “must arrange a make-up session before returning to the relevant task.”
opts: Arrange a make-up session before returning to the task
Ask a colleague to sign for them
Wait until the next annual review

qs.q: The company pays a bonus to workers who report hazards.
qs.why: The handbook gives reporting instructions but does not mention bonuses.
qs.ev: No bonus policy is stated.

qs.q: Eye protection is mandatory in the battery-______ area.
qs.why: The PPE section identifies the area.
qs.ev: “Eye protection is mandatory in the battery-charging area.”

qs.q: Choose the best heading for Paragraph D.
qs.why: Paragraph D describes absence reporting and training requirements.
qs.ev: “ABSENCE AND TRAINING.”

passages.title: Rental Flat and Local Travel Guide
passages.intro: Practical information for a new tenant
paras: MAPLE COURT TENANCY INFORMATION. Rent is due on the first day of each month and may be paid by online transfer or at the management office. Tenants should include their apartment number in the payment reference. If rent will be late, contact the office before the due date to discuss the situation; an automated reminder does not replace direct communication.

REPAIRS. Urgent problems such as a major water leak or loss of heat in winter should be reported by telephone to the emergency maintenance line. Routine requests, including a dripping tap or a damaged cupboard hinge, should be submitted through the resident portal. Include a photograph where possible and allow up to three working days for a response. Do not hire a contractor and deduct the cost from rent without written authorisation.

LOCAL TRANSIT. The number 18 bus stops outside Maple Court and connects with the central train station. On weekdays it runs every 20 minutes from 6:00 a.m. until 11:00 p.m.; on Sundays it runs every 30 minutes. A monthly pass can be purchased online or at the station kiosk. Passengers who buy a pass online should allow one business day for delivery if they request a physical card.

MOVE-OUT CHECKLIST. Tenants must give written notice according to the terms of their lease and arrange a final inspection. Remove all personal belongings, clean the oven and refrigerator, and return every key. The security deposit is assessed after the inspection; deductions may apply for damage beyond normal wear. Leaving keys in the flat does not count as formally returning them.

qs.q: When is rent due?
qs.why: The tenancy information gives the monthly due date.
qs.ev: “Rent is due on the first day of each month…”
opts: On the first day of each month
Three working days after a reminder
Whenever a tenant receives an email

qs.q: Tenants should include their apartment number with rent payments.
qs.why: The payment reference must include the apartment number.
qs.ev: “include their apartment number in the payment reference.”

qs.q: Which paragraph explains how to report a major water leak?
qs.why: Paragraph B directs urgent repair reports to the emergency line.
qs.ev: “should be reported by telephone to the emergency maintenance line.”

qs.q: The guide encourages tenants to deduct any repair cost from their rent.
qs.why: It explicitly says not to deduct costs without written authorisation.
qs.ev: “Do not hire a contractor and deduct the cost from rent without written authorisation.”

qs.q: Routine repair requests should be submitted through the resident ______.
qs.why: The guide gives the online method for routine repairs.
qs.ev: “should be submitted through the resident portal.”

qs.q: How often does the number 18 bus run on weekdays?
qs.why: The transit section gives a 20-minute weekday interval.
qs.ev: “on weekdays it runs every 20 minutes…”

qs.q: The number 18 bus operates until midnight every day.
qs.why: Weekday service ends at 11 p.m. and Sunday frequency differs.
qs.ev: “until 11:00 p.m.”

qs.q: Where can a monthly transit pass be purchased?
a: online or at the station kiosk
qs.why: The guide lists both purchase options.
qs.ev: “A monthly pass can be purchased online or at the station kiosk.”

qs.q: Which issue requires a telephone call?
qs.why: Loss of heat in winter is described as urgent.
qs.ev: “loss of heat in winter should be reported by telephone…”

qs.q: A physical transit card bought online may take one business day for ______.
qs.why: The guide warns of a one-business-day delivery period.
qs.ev: “allow one business day for delivery…”

qs.q: When is the security deposit assessed?
qs.why: The final paragraph links assessment to the inspection.
qs.ev: “The security deposit is assessed after the inspection…”
opts: When the first rent is paid
Immediately after the keys are mailed

qs.q: Normal wear always results in a deduction from the deposit.
qs.why: Deductions may apply to damage beyond normal wear.
qs.ev: “damage beyond normal wear.”

qs.q: Tenants must clean the oven and ______ before moving out.
qs.why: The move-out checklist names both appliances.
qs.ev: “clean the oven and refrigerator…”
